definitions.explanation: A smooth white surface used for writing with dry-erase markers. Standard equipment in offices, classrooms, and meeting rooms in Japan.

examples.japanese: ホワイトボード⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write it on the whiteboard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ホワイトボード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}した→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: I erased the whiteboard in the meeting room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ホワイトボード⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いて→描く：28436_kaku⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher drew a diagram on the whiteboard and explained it for us.

notes:
A loanword from English "whiteboard." Has largely replaced ⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧ (blackboard) in offices and many modern classrooms. Often abbreviated as WB in casual writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ホワイトボード⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write on the whiteboard
- ホワイトボード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to erase the whiteboard
- ホワイトボード⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦マーカー→マーカー：21828_maakaa⟧: whiteboard marker
- ホワイトボードイレーザー: whiteboard eraser

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧: blackboard, chalkboard — the traditional classroom writing surface using chalk
- ⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧: bulletin board, notice board — for posting notices, not for writing on directly
- {電子黒板|でんしこくばん}: electronic whiteboard, smart board — an interactive digital display
